articles.title: Bessent upset Lutnick didn't ban Nvidia chip exports to China-linked firm
articles.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is blaming Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick for allowing Megaspeed, the firm once led by alleged Chinese spy Alice Huang, to circumvent U.S. restrictions by funneling Nvidia chips to China, CBS News has learned. Megaspeed denies wrongdoing and China denies the spying allegations. Ed O'Keefe has the story.

articles.title: Nationwide FAA Ground Stop Lifted; Radar “Instability,” Old System Was Root Of Airspace Shutdown, Transportation Secretary Insists
articles.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration has “lifted” today’s nationwide grounding of flights. According to Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy, the root cause of the crisis was a radar “instability” issue that led to the shutting down this afternoon of domestic airspace. In great part, the antiquated system was overwhelmed, Duffy said.
